payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that among the three pre-training tasks, sentence reordering (SR) is identified as the most effective for pre-training.

claims.text: Sentence reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task.
SR works slightly better than next sentence generation (NSG) and masked document generation (MDG).
SR requires a comprehensive understanding of a document, which is beneficial for abstractive document summarization.
